manual_scene_review.observed: Actual unobscured Gazebo: cyan slider, yellow rail and attached red probe/green marker are visible; TF/point claims use independent native link readbacks.

limits: Pose/Twist teaching channels come from one actual joint query, not independent sensors or native sensor acquisition stamps.
Shadow header offset is deliberately injected; approximate matching does not correct a clock.
Raw Header.seq is per Publisher and kept intact; source identity is independently mapped from publication traces.
Receive wall lag and source publish-call simulator time are different evidence, neither is wire-transmission latency.
Latest-common-time TF and native GetLinkState are asynchronous and compared with explicit tolerances.
Separate student formulas remain blank and ungraded by reference acceptance.
